title: [main]planning worksheet requires second runof calculate regenerative plan
summary: The low-level code calculation engine now processes SKU-level production BOMs correctly, ensuring planning worksheets generate all required planning lines in a single run for multi-level assemblies when BOMs are defined at the SKU level rather than the item card.
key_points: CalcLevels procedure now traverses SKU-level BOMs in addition to item-card BOMs when computing low-level codes
New RecalcSKULowerLevels procedure propagates low-level codes downward through SKU-referenced BOMs
SKU Production BOM No. OnValidate now persists the recalculated low-level code instead of only computing it
Eliminates the need for users to run Calculate Regenerative Plan twice for SKU-only multi-level BOM structures
